Maya (Acme): Hey support — after SSO this morning I can see org but when I switch into the 'marketing-prod' project the console shows 403 Permission Denied. Worked yesterday. Ticket INC-6789. Screenshot attached.
Sophia (Support): Sorry about that, Maya — can you confirm: browser + version, did you try incognito, and paste the x-request-id from the failing network call? Also which account/email you used to sign in?
Maya (Acme): Chrome 118.0.5993, tried incognito and still 403. x-request-id: req-abc123. I signed in with sso (m@acme). I can still hit our API keys from service-to-service, only console UI blocked.
Sophia (Support): Thanks. I'm escalating to SRE to look at the backend auth path with that request id. In the meantime: if you can, try signing out of Okta and sign back in, and then accept the SSO prompt again.
Ethan (SRE): Pulling logs for req-abc123 now. Quick snapshot: the token exchange returned scopes openid/profile only, the "roles" claim is missing for that session. Backend auth rejects because console requires roles/org membership claim for project actions.
Ethan (SRE): log snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-03-17T23:05:04Z auth.gateway INFO req=req-abc123 sub=m@acme aud=console scopes=[openid,profile] claims={sub:"m@acme", org_id:"org-123", roles:null}
authz: denied missing roles claim -> 403
```
Ethan (SRE): Looks like the delegated token presented by the identity provider had roles dropped. That explains why API calls with service keys still work (they use a different auth path).
Nora (DevEx): Could be a recent IdP tweak that trims long claims for delegated sessions. Does your org use SCIM group-sync and map groups->roles? If yes, try triggering an immediate group sync on the IdP side and re-login.
Maya (Acme): Triggered a group sync in Okta and re-auth'd — still 403. Anything else we can try from our side?
TokenBot: session.revoke detected for token_id=tok-zz01 at 2026-03-17T22:58:12Z (system automation)
Ethan (SRE): Ok — I see an automated session refresh from the IdP around 22:58 that reissued a token for delegated clients and apparently omitted roles for guest-scoped flows. I'm opening an IdP escalation: IDP-2026 and linking logs.
Sophia (Support): Short-term workaround: we can generate a temporary 24h org-admin support invite for you so you can complete urgent console work while IdP fixes the claim mapping. Want me to create that now?
Maya (Acme): Yes please — we need to update a billing contact and a dashboard tonight.
Sophia (Support): Done — created a time-limited support invite (expires in 2 hours). Accept the link in your inbox and try the project switch again.
Maya (Acme): Accepted — I can now access project actions. Billing tab visible. :relieved:
Ethan (SRE): Root cause summary for the ticket: IdP token-exchange path for delegated console sessions started dropping the roles/groups claim after a policy rollback. That made our console auth path see a valid session but no roles -> 403. Work items: (1) IdP to fix claim preservation (IDP-2026), (2) backend to add a defensive fallback log indicating which required claim missing and user-facing guidance, (3) add synthetic test to catch claim-trim regressions in staging.
Nora (DevEx): I'll file a follow-up in our infra backlog to improve the UX message (replace generic 403 with "roles claim missing — reauthenticate or contact admin") and add a diagnostic buttton that shows current token claims to users (redacted).
Sophia (Support): Closing the user-facing ticket since access restored via temporary invite. Keeping internal tickets open: INC-6789 (customer), IDP-2026 (IdP), RDW-FA-204 (backend logging). Maya, reopen if anything else pops up — and sorry for the disruption. :bow:
Maya (Acme): Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast help.
